symbols.name: BenchmarkResult
symbols.documentation:
Fishing multiplier, raw SPR, SSB in tonnes, recruitment in thousands, dead yield in tonnes and pooled annual F for one equilibrium.
@details scale multiplies the reference fleet/season pattern. spr is raw SPR, ssb/yield are tonnes, recruitment is thousands of fish and annual_f is pooled SS3 units 4. Scale and reported annual F are different quantities.
symbols.purpose: Fishing multiplier, raw SPR, SSB in tonnes, recruitment in thousands, dead yield in tonnes and pooled annual F for one equilibrium.

symbols.name: Benchmarks
symbols.documentation:
Equilibrium reference-point calculator holding selected historical fleet/season fishing proportions and terminal biology.
@details The object borrows data and native parameter maps, which must outlive it. Rates are scaled proportionally across fleets/seasons; the annual F output is pooled SS3 units 4 over ages 1..10, not the input multiplier. Averaging the 2019..2021 fishing pattern answers a different reference-point question from using terminal-2021 rates.
symbols.purpose: Equilibrium reference-point calculator holding selected historical fleet/season fishing proportions and terminal biology.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::operator()

symbols.purpose: Use bracket expansion and bisection to find a valid fractional SPR or virgin-biomass target.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::msy
symbols.purpose: Find maximum equilibrium yield through a bracketed fourth-order numerical derivative root, avoiding flat-objective rounding noise.

Integrated selectivity in numbers and biomass, with selected mean length and weight for a sex/age cell.

symbols.purpose: Integrated selectivity in numbers and biomass, with selected mean length and weight for a sex/age cell.

symbols.name: csv_number

symbols.name: State
symbols.documentation:
Fixed 2-sex by 16-age abundance array. Cells are thousands of fish; age 15 is the plus group.
@details Index with cell(sex,age), not a one-based SS3 sex/age code. Use zero_state before accumulation: default construction of supported AD types is not a numerical-zero contract.
symbols.purpose: Fixed 2-sex by 16-age abundance array. Cells are thousands of fish; age 15 is the plus group.

symbols.name: zero_state
symbols.purpose: Construct an explicitly zero-filled sex-by-age state, including AD scalars whose default constructor does not initialize a numerical zero.

symbols.name: cell
symbols.purpose: Map zero-based sex and age to the flattened 32-cell population-state index; callers supply sex 0-1 and age 0-15.

symbols.name: Dimensions
symbols.documentation:
Assessment calendar, four seasonal durations, spawning month, area count and plus-group age.
@details first_year/last_year are inclusive calendar years. seasons/subseasons and plus_age describe the supported discretization; season_months contains durations, not start months. spawn_month is one-based calendar timing.
symbols.purpose: Assessment calendar, four seasonal durations, spawning month, area count and plus-group age.

symbols.name: Fleet
symbols.documentation:
One-based fleet identity, type, observation timing, catch units, multiplier flag and source name.
@details id is one-based and matches observation records. type distinguishes fishing/index fleets; catch_units=1 is biomass and 2 is numbers. timing controls point versus integrated sampling. This schema has one area and no supported catch multipliers.
symbols.purpose: One-based fleet identity, type, observation timing, catch units, multiplier flag and source name.

symbols.name: Catch
symbols.documentation:
One observed fleet-season catch with year, value and log-scale standard error; fleet units select tonnes or thousands of fish.
@details value follows the referenced fleet units, while log_se is a log-scale error. year=-999 carries the supported initialization observation; normal rows are historical year/season catches, not estimates of apical F.
symbols.purpose: One observed fleet-season catch with year, value and log-scale standard error; fleet units select tonnes or thousands of fish.

symbols.name: Index
symbols.documentation:
Abundance-index observation and inclusion flag with source month, fleet, positive observation and log standard error.
@details month retains source fractional timing; value and log_se must be positive for included lognormal observations. use controls inclusion without deleting provenance rows. Special recruitment-unit indices are handled explicitly in the likelihood.
symbols.purpose: Abundance-index observation and inclusion flag with source month, fleet, positive observation and log standard error.

symbols.name: Composition
symbols.documentation:
Length-composition sample, inclusion flag, sex/partition coding, sample size and both source blocks of 51 bins.
@details values retains both 51-bin source blocks. For the supplied combined-sex data the second block duplicates the first and is not a second independent sample. Negative source years set use=false; sample_size already contains the supplied weighting.
symbols.purpose: Length-composition sample, inclusion flag, sex/partition coding, sample size and both source blocks of 51 bins.

symbols.name: Parameter
symbols.documentation:
Named SS3 control specification, original numeric columns and source line for provenance.
@details columns preserves the source control order: lower, upper, initial and estimation metadata. Estimated phases are read from column 6; extended selectivity rows also carry block number/function in columns 12/13. source_line supports diagnostics.
symbols.purpose: Named SS3 control specification, original numeric columns and source line for provenance.

symbols.name: Growth
symbols.documentation:
Sex-specific von Bertalanffy reference ages/lengths, coefficient of variation and length-weight coefficients.
@details Lengths are cm and k is annual. Reference lengths are tied to age1/age2; cv_young/cv_old are coefficients of variation, not length SDs. weight_coefficient and weight_power map individual cm length to kg weight.
symbols.purpose: Sex-specific von Bertalanffy reference ages/lengths, coefficient of variation and length-weight coefficients.

symbols.name: Biology
symbols.documentation:
Fixed natural mortality, sex-specific growth, maturity, sex allocation and settlement settings.
@details natural_mortality is sex-major annual M. growth has one record per sex; maturity and settlement settings describe the supplied control setup. Fitted native parameter maps remain authoritative for parameters evaluated by the biological functions.
symbols.purpose: Fixed natural mortality, sex-specific growth, maturity, sex allocation and settlement settings.

symbols.name: InputData
symbols.documentation:
Complete supported swordfish observation and control schema; unsupported SS3 variants are rejected rather than approximated silently.
@details This object owns parsed observations and controls; no trajectory from Report.sso is a population driver. Arrays preserve source codes and ordering, and validate checks the explicitly supported schema. Further method-specific layout checks occur before likelihood/projection evaluation.
symbols.purpose: Complete supported swordfish observation and control schema; unsupported SS3 variants are rejected rather than approximated silently.

symbols.name: InputData::validate
symbols.documentation: Check supported dimensions, season durations, mortality, fleet/catch definitions and growth before evaluating the imported data.
symbols.purpose: Check supported dimensions, season durations, mortality, fleet/catch definitions and growth before evaluating the imported data.

symbols.name: validate_parameter_covariance
symbols.documentation:
Require a nonempty finite, symmetric, positive-definite parameter covariance before propagation; do not regularize silently.
@param covariance Square, finite, symmetric positive-definite covariance of independent fitting coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Require a nonempty finite, symmetric, positive-definite parameter covariance before propagation; do not regularize silently.

symbols.name: delta_covariance
symbols.signature: Eigen::MatrixXd delta_covariance(const Eigen::MatrixXd & jacobian, const Eigen::MatrixXd & covariance)
symbols.purpose: Propagate a compatible finite output Jacobian through the full parameter covariance as J V J-transpose, preserving correlations.

symbols.name: PositiveInterval
symbols.documentation:
Native standard error and positive lower/upper pointwise log-scale Wald endpoints.
@details se is native-scale delta-method uncertainty. lower/upper are positive log-scale Wald endpoints, so their arithmetic midpoint need not equal the estimate. No process uncertainty is added.
symbols.purpose: Native standard error and positive lower/upper pointwise log-scale Wald endpoints.

symbols.name: positive_delta_interval
symbols.purpose: Construct a pointwise positive 95% interval from a positive estimate and nonnegative native variance; reject nonfinite results.

symbols.name: exposure
symbols.signature: T exposure(const T & z, double duration)
symbols.purpose: Calculate the stable Baranov exposure (1-exp(-Z*duration))/Z, using a near-zero expansion; Z is an annual rate and duration is years.

symbols.name: SeasonResult
symbols.documentation:
Seasonal survivors, natural deaths and fleet catch numbers, all on the same thousands-of-fish scale as the starting state.
@details survivors and natural_deaths are sex-major states; catch_numbers is indexed by fleet then sex/age. advance_season writes every returned cell. Numbers are thousands, so population mass balance is tested on that common scale.
symbols.purpose: Seasonal survivors, natural deaths and fleet catch numbers, all on the same thousands-of-fish scale as the starting state.

symbols.name: ObservationTime
symbols.documentation:
Resolved season, within-year observation time, age-length-key time and elapsed seasonal survival duration.
@details season is one-based. time and alk_time are calendar-year fractions; elapsed is time since the season start. Negative elapsed is an intentional sentinel for season-integrated sampling, not a negative survival duration.

symbols.name: LengthKeys
symbols.documentation:
Sex-specific cached age-length keys for a single within-year time in one likelihood evaluation.
@details Keys are indexed first by sex, then age, then length bin. A cached key must have the same parameters and observation integration time as its consumer; AD keys cannot cross an evaluation/tape boundary.
symbols.purpose: Sex-specific cached age-length keys for a single within-year time in one likelihood evaluation.

symbols.signature: std::array<std::vector<T>, 2> sampled_lengths(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const PopulationSeason<T> & row, const std::vector<T> & curve, const ObservationTime & time, const LengthKeys<T> * cached)

symbols.name: IndexFit
symbols.documentation:
Index observation prediction, profiled catchability, residual, error and unweighted likelihood contribution.
@details observation/prediction retain index fleet units, se is log-scale, and log_q is analytically profiled catchability. nll is an unweighted contribution; component lambdas are applied in the aggregate objective.
symbols.purpose: Index observation prediction, profiled catchability, residual, error and unweighted likelihood contribution.

symbols.name: LengthFit
symbols.documentation:
Length-sample prediction and diagnostics, including effective sample size, observed/predicted means and deviance.
@details observed/expected are stabilized normalized bin proportions. sample_size is the supplied effective N, means are cm, and nll is the unweighted multinomial perfect-fit-offset contribution.
symbols.purpose: Length-sample prediction and diagnostics, including effective sample size, observed/predicted means and deviance.

symbols.name: LikelihoodResult
symbols.documentation:
Joint objective total, named weighted components, fitted indices and included length-sample diagnostics.
@details total is the weighted joint objective. components keeps named terms for SS3 comparisons, while indices/lengths retain per-observation diagnostics. Profiled Q values do not add independent optimization coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Joint objective total, named weighted components, fitted indices and included length-sample diagnostics.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel
symbols.documentation:
Quadra model adapter for the 84-coordinate joint penalized-likelihood target; historical recruitment deviations are optimized, not Laplace-integrated.
@details This is joint penalized maximum likelihood: recruitment deviations are optimized parameters, not Laplace-integrated latent variables. The logit is only an optimization reparameterization; no transformation-density Jacobian is added. The dependent final main recruitment deviation is reconstructed after transforming the independent coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Quadra model adapter for the 84-coordinate joint penalized-likelihood target; historical recruitment deviations are optimized, not Laplace-integrated.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::FreeParameter
symbols.documentation:
One independent fitting coordinate: canonical name, native bounds/value and optional recruitment year.
@details lo/hi/value are native bounds and the native starting value. year=0 identifies a control parameter; a nonzero year identifies a recruitment deviation. Its position in free defines the covariance/gradient coordinate order.
symbols.purpose: One independent fitting coordinate: canonical name, native bounds/value and optional recruitment year.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::SwordfishModel
symbols.signature: SwordfishModel::SwordfishModel(InputData input, ParameterValues<double> p, Deviations<double> deviations)
symbols.purpose: Build the fitting-coordinate schema from estimated control parameters and independent early/main recruitment deviations.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::parameter_names_impl
symbols.documentation:
Return canonical names in the same order as fitting coordinates and covariance matrices.
@return Stable names used to label fitting coordinates, gradients and covariance rows.
symbols.purpose: Return canonical names in the same order as fitting coordinates and covariance matrices.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::initial_vector
symbols.documentation:
Transform interior native starting values to bounded-logit coordinates and reject starts at or beyond bounds.
@return Independent bounded-logit coordinates in parameter_names_impl order.
symbols.purpose: Transform interior native starting values to bounded-logit coordinates and reject starts at or beyond bounds.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::initial_parameters
symbols.documentation:
Create Quadra's parameter vector, treating every independent coordinate as a joint optimized parameter.
@return Quadra ParameterVector with all independent coordinates treated as optimized joint parameters.
symbols.purpose: Create Quadra's parameter vector, treating every independent coordinate as a joint optimized parameter.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::decode
symbols.signature: std::pair<ParameterValues<T>, Deviations<T>> SwordfishModel::decode(const std::vector<T> & x) const
symbols.purpose: Transform fitting coordinates to native parameters/deviations and enforce the zero-sum main-deviation constraint, including the dependent final year.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::likelihood
symbols.purpose: Decode coordinates, run the population and return the complete component-wise likelihood result.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::operator()

symbols.signature: T SwordfishModel::evaluate_impl(const std::vector<T> & x, quadra::ModelReportContext & context) const
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the scalar objective through Quadra's model interface and register it in the report context.

symbols.name: Deviations
symbols.documentation:
Map recruitment years to fitted log recruitment deviations, including early age-structure deviations.
@details Keys include early age-structure and historical main recruitment years. Values are additive log deviations. The map itself does not impose the main-period zero-sum constraint; SwordfishModel::decode reconstructs its dependent final year.
symbols.purpose: Map recruitment years to fitted log recruitment deviations, including early age-structure deviations.

symbols.name: SeasonalBiology
symbols.documentation:
Per-season selected numbers, selected weight, beginning weights and mature weights for mortality and biomass calculations.
@details selectivity is dimensionless number selection, selected_biomass integrates selected kg weight, and weight_begin is beginning-season kg weight. mature_weight is the female maturity/fecundity contribution used at the supported spawning integration time.
symbols.purpose: Per-season selected numbers, selected weight, beginning weights and mature weights for mortality and biomass calculations.

symbols.name: seasonal_biology
symbols.signature: SeasonalBiology<T> seasonal_biology(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const std::vector<std::vector<T>> & curves, int season)
symbols.purpose: Integrate growth, selectivity and mature weight for one of four seasons; produce all fleet/sex/age factors needed by population dynamics.

symbols.name: fishing_at_age

symbols.name: HybridResult
symbols.documentation:
Hybrid-catch solution containing fleet apical rates, predicted catches and mortality-at-age arrays.
@details apical_f and fishing are annual mortality rates, not quarterly removals. predicted_catch follows each fleet unit code, so summed mixed-unit catches are only used where SS3 deliberately uses that tuning heuristic.
symbols.purpose: Hybrid-catch solution containing fleet apical rates, predicted catches and mortality-at-age arrays.

symbols.name: HybridResult::HybridResult<T>
symbols.documentation: Explicitly initialize accumulated catch and apical-rate scalars to numerical zero, including AD types.
symbols.purpose: Explicitly initialize accumulated catch and apical-rate scalars to numerical zero, including AD types.

symbols.name: recruitment_bias
symbols.signature: double recruitment_bias(const InputData & data, int year)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the piecewise recruitment-bias ramp for a historical year from the advanced control settings.

symbols.name: adjusted_recruitment
symbols.signature: T adjusted_recruitment(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const Deviations<T> & dev, int year, const T & expected)

symbols.purpose: Combine beginning numbers, fishing mortality and mature weights to compute spawning biomass under SS3 v3.30.20 timing.

symbols.name: Equilibrium
symbols.documentation:
Per-season beginning population states, equilibrium recruitment and spawning biomass for constant seasonal mortality.
@details beginning contains each season state after any settlement occurring at that season start. recruitment is constant annual recruitment in thousands; ssb is the spawning-season mature biomass in tonnes. The plus group includes survivors already at age 15.
symbols.purpose: Per-season beginning population states, equilibrium recruitment and spawning biomass for constant seasonal mortality.

symbols.name: equilibrium
symbols.signature: Equilibrium<T> equilibrium(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const std::array<SeasonalBiology<T>, 4> & biology, const std::array<std::array<T, nfishing>, 4> & apical, const T & recruitment)

symbols.name: InitialPopulation
symbols.documentation:
Virgin and initially fished equilibria plus January starting abundance after early recruitment deviations.
@details virgin and initial are distinct stationary populations. january starts from the initially fished equilibrium and then incorporates early recruitment deviations/bias; substituting virgin recruitment would change the starting age structure.
symbols.purpose: Virgin and initially fished equilibria plus January starting abundance after early recruitment deviations.

symbols.name: initialize_population
symbols.signature: InitialPopulation<T> initialize_population(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const Deviations<T> & deviations, const std::array<SeasonalBiology<T>, 4> & biology)
symbols.purpose: Calculate virgin and initial-fishing Beverton-Holt equilibria, then apply early deviations and bias correction to the initial age structure.

symbols.name: PopulationSeason
